Minefield: You have five Minefield markers for the battle. On the reverse side, three of them are HY-Pex mines (see below) and two are
blank. Set up all your Minefield markers as if they were one item of equipment. Each must be set up reverse-side down (their specifics
aren’t revealed), more than 2" from other markers, access points and Accessible terrain, and more than 6" from your opponent’s drop
zone and your other Minefield markers. Whenever this operative is readied, if it’s not within control range of enemy operatives, you can
reset one of your flipped Minefield markers that’s within its control range (flip the marker back over again).
HY-Pex Mines: Whenever one of your reverse-side down Minefield markers is both within an enemy operative’s control range and not
within a friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR operative’s control range, flip the marker over. If it’s a blank, there’s no effect. If it’s a HY-Pex
mine, inflict 3 damage on that enemy operative and roll one D6: if the result is less than that enemy operative’s Save stat, inflict additional
damage on it equal to the dice result; regardless of the result, if it isn’t incapacitated, end its action (if any), even if that action’s effects
aren’t fulfilled. If it cannot be placed, move it the minimum amount to do so. Regardless, that marker isn’t removed.
HERNKYN YAEGIR , LEAGUES OF VOTANN, IRONBRAEK 28

cards.text:
远行者猎手
阵营规则
机敏
远行者猎手专精于自给自足。这些饱经历练的战士
们往往会在缺乏支援的任务中面对无数突发状况。
在这种情况下，猎手小队会通过灵活应变适应危险
环境和敌方活动。
在第一个战略阶段之后每个战略阶段的就绪步骤
中，您会通过杀戮区中不位于敌方特工控制范围
内的己方远行者猎手特工数量获得一定数量的
机敏点数。在每个转折点结束时，弃置己方的机
敏点数。

cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FACTION RULE
RESOURCEFUL
Hernkyn Yaegirs are self-sufficiency specialists. They are
also skilled warriors who, usually unsupported, embark
upon missions equipped for countless contingencies.
This allows them to adapt to hazardous environments
and enemy actions with decisive speed.
In the Ready step of each Strategy phase after
the first, you gain Resourceful points determined
by the number of friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR
operatives in the killzone that aren’t within control
range of enemy operatives. At the end of each
turning point, discard your Resourceful points.
OPERATIVES RESOURCEFUL POINTS
5+ 2
1-4 1
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:

可以花费 1 点机敏点数并选择以下一个效果：
• 在特工执行一次行动之前或者之后，如果特工
不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使
用本规则，若使用，直到激活结束前，那名己
方特工的 APL 属性增加 1 点。
• 在该特工被激活时，如果该特工不位于敌方特
工的控制范围内，那么回复 D3+1 处失去的
耐伤。
cards.text_en:
You can spend 1 of your Resourceful points
during each activation of each friendly HERNKYN
YAEGIR operative to do one of the following:
• Before or after it performs an action, if it’s
not within control range of enemy operatives,
you can use this rule. If you do, add 1 to that
friendly operative’s APL stat until the end of
its activation.
• When it’s activated, if it’s not within control
range of enemy operatives, it regains up to
D3+1 lost wounds.

cards.text:

无畏探险家
猎手们是氏族中最先踏上新世界的炉裔，常常会面
临长时间部署，他们十分擅长对行动区域进行快速
探索和评估。
第一个转折点的战略计划。完全位于己方降落区

次无消耗的转移行动。但那些移动必须在其结束
时完全位于己方降落区 4" 内。

The first of their kindred to set foot on new worlds,

cards.text:
远行者猎手
战略计谋
隐秘交战
作为经验丰富的生存专家，远行者猎手是老练
的猎人，擅长于从暗处追踪猎物并进行交战。
每当一名己方远行者猎手特工进行射击时，若
从目标视角而言它处于掩护中，则它的武器获
得“平衡”武器规则。请注意，瞄准直线依然应
当由您的对手确定（即由他们决定从自己特工底
盘的哪个点划出瞄准直线）。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
STRATEGY PLOY
HIDDEN ENGAGEMENT
Being experienced survivalists, Hernkyn Yaegirs are
skilled hunters, well used to stalking and engaging their
prey from the shadows.
Whenever a friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR
operative is shooting, if it’s in cover from the
target’s perspective, that friendly operative’s
weapons have the Balanced weapon rule. Note
that your opponent still determines the targeting
lines for this (i.e. they decide which point of their
operative’s base targeting lines are drawn from).

cards.text:
远行者猎手
战略计谋
娴熟刀法
远行者猎手对使用等离子尖刀和其他近战武器
进行了大量训练，能够无情且精确地挥舞这
些武器。
每当一名己方远行者猎手特工进行近战或在拥
有隐匿命令的情况下进行反击时，其近战武器
的攻击属性增加 1 点（最多提升至 4），并且拥
有“平衡”武器规则；如果那件武器已经拥有“
平衡”武器规则，则会拥有“无休”武器规则作
为替代。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
STRATEGY PLOY
MASTERFUL BLADEWORK
Yaegirs are extensively trained in the use of plasma
knives and other close combat weapons, wielding them
with ruthless precision.
Whenever a friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR
operative is fighting, or has a Conceal order and
is retaliating, add 1 to the Atk stat of its melee
weapons (to a maximum of 4) and they have the
Balanced weapon rule; if the weapon already has
that weapon rule, it has the Ceaseless weapon
rule instead of Balanced.

cards.text:
远行者猎手
战略计谋
坚毅求生家
远行者猎手一辈子都在探索前线，他们在面对
伤害时表现得极为刚毅。
当每名己方远行者猎手特工在转折点中第一次
由于攻击骰受到伤害时，在结算攻击骰步骤中，
您可以将伤害减半（向上取整，至多减少至 2
点）。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
STRATEGY PLOY
TOUGH SURVIVALISTS
A lifetime of frontier exploration coupled with their
kind’s natural fortitude renders Hernkyn Yaegirs highly
resistant to injury.
The first time an attack dice inflicts damage
on each friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR operative
during the turning point in the Resolve Attack
Dice step, you can halve that inflicted damage
(rounding up, to a minimum of 2).

cards.text:
远行者猎手
战略计谋
各就各位
远行者猎手会在追踪猎物上付出大量耐心，并
利用周围环境隐蔽自己，免遭窥视。
每当一名己方远行者猎手特工拥有隐匿命令且
处于掩护中，则其无法被选为有效目标，本规
则的优先度高于所有其他规则（例如‘追踪’
武器规则和制高点地形)，除非攻击者位于特工
的 2" 内。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
STRATEGY PLOY
IN POSITION
Hernkyn Yaegirs stalk their enemies with great patience,
using the surrounding terrain to conceal themselves
from prying eyes.
Whenever a friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR
operative has a Conceal order and is in cover,
it cannot be selected as a valid target, taking
precedence over all other rules (e.g. Seek,
Vantage terrain) except being within 2".

cards.text:
远行者猎手
交战计谋
坚韧
远行者猎手身形浑厚坚毅，坚韧不拔，面对其
他种族早已慌乱不堪的伤势仍能镇定自若。
一名特工对一名己方远行者猎手特工进行射击
时，当您拿取己方防御骰时使用此交战计谋。将
攻击者保留的关键成功改为普通成功（任意已经
结算的武器规则同样会失去效果，例如“穿刺”
武器规则的暴击）。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FIREFIGHT PLOY
STURDY
Stocky and stalwart, Hernkyn Yaegirs grit their teeth and
shrug off wounds that would fell other species.
Use this firefight ploy when an operative is
shooting a friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR operative,
when you collect your defence dice. Change the
attacker’s retained critical successes to normal
successes (any weapon rules they’ve already
resolved aren’t affected, e.g. Piercing Crits).

cards.text:
远行者猎手
交战计谋
羁绊稳固
远行者猎手组成的小队关系极为紧密，会在行
动中展现出本能般的协调。
当一名己方远行者猎手特工激活时使用此交战
计谋。选择位于那名特工 3" 内且可见的另一名
己方远行者猎手特工。在第一名特工待机时，
您可以在对手激活前激活那个另一名己方特工。
在另一名己方特工激活后，您的对手可以照常激
活特工。
若这个转折点中使用过撞锤交涉战略计划，则两
名特工均不能为噪枪士特工。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FIREFIGHT PLOY
BONDS THAT BIND
Squads of Hernkyn Yaegirs are exceptionally close-knit
and operate with instinctive coordination.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly HERNKYN
YAEGIR operative is activated. Select one other
ready friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR operative
visible to and within 3" of that operative. When
that first friendly operative is expended, you can
activate that other friendly operative before your
opponent activates. When that other operative
is expended, your opponent then activates
as normal.
Neither operative can be a BOMBAST operative if
its Wroughtlock Negotiation STRATEGIC GAMBIT
has been used this turning point.

cards.text:
远行者猎手
交战计谋
绝不抛弃
所有炉裔都希望在死后回到自己的先祖核心。
因此远行者会全力保证没有陨落者被抛弃。
当一名己方远行者猎手特工残废时使用此交战
计谋。在那名特工从杀戮区移除前，将杀戮区中
己方的陨落族人标识移除（如果有），然后将其
放置在那名特工的控制范围内，之后，那名特工
照常被移出杀戮区。
当一名在己方陨落族人标识 3" 内的己方远行者猎
手特工射击，近战或反击时，在掷攻击骰步骤
中，您可以将己方的一枚失败保留为普通成功，
或将一枚普通成功保留为关键成功。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FIREFIGHT PLOY
NO KIN LEFT BEHIND
All Kin desire to return to their Hold’s Ancestor Core
upon their death. Hernkyn will fight tooth and nail to
ensure that none of their fallen are left behind.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly HERNKYN
YAEGIR operative is incapacitated. Before that
operative is removed from the killzone, remove
your Fallen Kin marker from the killzone (if any),
then place it within that operative’s control range.
That operative is then removed from the killzone
as normal.
Whenever a friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR
operative within 3" of your Fallen Kin marker
is shooting, fighting or retaliating, in the Roll
Attack Dice step, you can retain one of your fails
as a normal success instead of discarding it, or
retain one of your normal successes as a critical
success instead.

cards.text:
远行者猎手
交战计谋
严密防御
炉裔在防守中会展现出坚韧不拔的特质，能在
敌人的步步紧逼下维持精准且密集的火力。
当一名敌方特工在一名己方远行者猎手特工控
制范围内结束冲锋行动时使用此交战计谋。选择
位于那名己方特工 6" 内，对其可见且不位于敌
方特工控制范围内的另一名己方远行者猎手特
工。被选中的特工可以执行一次无消耗的射击行
动。在那次行动中：
• 即便那名敌方特工位于一名己方特工控制范围
内，那名敌方特工也可以作为目标。
• 其他敌方特工不能被选为有效目标。
• 您不能选择破片或穿甲手雷，也不能选择拥
有“爆炸”或“x" 毁灭 x”武器规则（即带有
距离的毁灭）的武器。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FIREFIGHT PLOY
STALWART DEFENCE
The Kin are steadfast and determined in defence. They
maintain accurate and punishing fire even as their
enemies close in.
Use this firefight ploy when an enemy operative
ends the Charge action within control range of
a friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR operative. Select
one other friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR operative
visible to and within 6" of that friendly operative,
but that isn’t itself within control range of enemy
operatives. The selected operative can perform a
free Shoot action. During that action:
• It can target that enemy operative even though
it’s within control range of a friendly operative.
• You cannot select any other enemy operative
as a valid target.
• You cannot select a frag or krak grenade, or
a weapon with the Blast or x" Devastating
x weapon rule (i.e. Devastating with a distance).

cards.text:
远行者猎手
阵营装备
等离子尖刀
等离子尖刀极为炽热的刃面足够切开数尺厚的
坚实金属。无论是护甲，还是骨肉都难以抵挡
其锋芒。
己方远行者猎手特工获得下列近战武器。请注
意，一部分特工已经拥有了这个武器且属性更
佳，在这种情况下请使用属性更佳的版本，并且
那件武器在战斗中获得“平衡”武器规则。
名称攻击命中伤害
等离子尖刀 3 4+ 3/5
武器规则
致命 5+
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FACTION EQUIPMENT
PLASMA KNIVES
The superheated edge of a plasma knife can slice
through several inches of solid metal. Armour and bone
are no match for such a cutting edge.
Friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR operatives have
the following melee weapon. Note that some
operatives already have this weapon but with
better stats; in that instance, use the better
version, and that weapon has the Balanced
weapon rule for the battle.
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Plasma knife 3 4+ 3/5
WR
Lethal 5+

cards.text:
远行者猎手
阵营装备
精准爆矢弹药
这种特制爆矢弹药装有稳定翼面，能在极限距
离提高其精准性和杀伤力。
每个转折点限两次，当一名己方远行者猎手特
工执行射击行动且选择了爆矢霰弹枪（远距离）
时，您便可以使用这个规则。若此，直到那个行
动结束前，将那个武器的命中属性和两个伤害属
性各自增加 1 点，并且那个武器拥有“精准 1”
武器规则。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FACTION EQUIPMENT
STABILISED BOLT SHELLS
Fitted with fin stabilisers, these specially crafted bolt
shells are designed to enhance accuracy and lethality at
extreme range.
Up to twice per turning point, whenever a friendly
HERNKYN YAEGIR operative is performing the
Shoot action and you select a bolt shotgun (long
range), you can use this rule. If you do, until the
end of that action, improve the Hit stat of that
weapon by 1 and add 1 to both of its Dmg stats,
and that weapon has the Accurate 1 weapon rule.

cards.text:
远行者猎手
阵营装备
烈焰爆矢弹药
这种爆矢弹药装填了破片和磷火，会在撞击后
的爆炸中散播出一大片致命的燃烧弹片。
每个转折点一次，当一名己方远行者猎手特工
执行射击行动且选择了爆矢霰弹枪（近距离）
时，您便可以使用这个规则。若此，直到那个行
动结束前，那个武器获得“爆炸 1"”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FACTION EQUIPMENT
FIRESTORM BOLT SHELLS
These bolt rounds are packed with shrapnel and
phosphor, detonating on impact and emitting a cloud of
lethal burning shards.
Once per turning point, when a friendly HERNKYN
YAEGIR operative is performing the Shoot action
and you select a bolt shotgun (short range), you
can use this rule. If you do, until the end of that
action, that weapon has the Blast 1" weapon rule.

cards.text:
远行者猎手
阵营装备
KV-陶钢防护服
远行者猎手通常会穿着轻型护甲，而这种轻薄
且极具弹性的陶钢防护服能为使用者提供一层
额外的防护。
每当一名特工对一名己方远行者猎手特工使用
带有“爆炸”或“洪流”武器规则的远程武器执
行射击行动时，您可以重掷一枚己方防御骰。此
外，己方远行者猎手特工在那个流程中不会受
到“x" 毁灭 x”武器规则（即带有距离的毁灭）
的效果影响，除非它们是这一流程中的目标。
cards.text_en:
HERNKYN YAEGIR
FACTION EQUIPMENT
KV-CERAMIDE UNDERSUIT
Hernkyn Yaegirs ordinarily wear only light armour. These
thin but resilient semi-ceramic undersuits provide the
wearer with an additional layer of protection.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
HERNKYN YAEGIR operative, if the ranged
weapon in that sequence has the Blast or Torrent
weapon rule, you can re-roll one of your defence
dice. In addition, friendly HERNKYN YAEGIR
operatives aren’t affected by the x" Devastating
x weapon rule (i.e. Devastating with a distance)
unless they are the target during that sequence.
